component.name: Overtalk
component.summary: Record meetings and keep notes you can trace to the source

description.p: Overtalk is a meeting notebook that runs on your computer. It records your microphone and call audio, transcribes the conversation, and turns it into notes where each point links back to the passage it came from.

ul.li: Record or import a meeting, pause and resume, and recover interrupted work
Search timestamped transcripts, follow playback and name speakers
Generate and edit notes, check the cited passage, and export PDF, DOCX, Markdown, TXT or JSON
Group meetings by project and ask questions across your library with sources you can open

description.p: Meetings and settings are stored locally. Speech and summary models are downloaded when you choose them and run on your computer. Cloud AI providers are optional and receive content only when you choose them. Telemetry and automatic updates are disabled.
